$comment: 土狗 $TUGOU — every user-facing string, both languages. Consumed by the vanilla-JS i18n layer described in DESIGN.md#i18n-contract: data-i18n="key" -> textContent, data-i18n-attr="attr:key; attr:key" -> setAttribute. Fallback chain is en -> zh -> key; zh is the fallback, NOT en. strings.zh and strings.en carry identical key sets. Arrays under data[] are consumed directly by JS and every entry carries both zh and en. NOTHING here may be injected with innerHTML. PARITY RULE, checked before launch: en is a translation of zh and may not carry a proposition, joke or citation that its zh counterpart does not — zh is the original and must read as complete without the en (DESIGN.md#industry, #donts "Don't let English lead"). PUNCTUATION: simplified body copy quotes with “…” and nests with ‘…’, the mainland convention; the corner brackets U+300C/U+300D and U+300E/U+300F appear nowhere in this file, including inside quoted sources — Baidu Baike itself sets that line with “”.

traditionalRuns.$comment: Strings intentionally written in traditional characters because that is how the OBJECT is written: 匾额 plaques, 对联 door-couplet lintels, 印章 seals. That is the entire list — the 荣誉证书 is deliberately not on it, because a 荣誉证书 is a mainland institutional object and is printed simplified, header included (DESIGN.md#Cultural-contract §8). Traditional characters appear ONLY in these strings: running simplified body copy never quotes a plaque in traditional, it quotes it in simplified (see plaques[].zhSimplified). Wrap each in lang="zh-Hant" so a zh-Hans root does not pull Hans glyph variants out of a CJK-unified font.

zh.whatis.title: 什么是土狗？
zh.whatis.lead: 土狗，本指中华田园犬——不纯种、不名贵、看家护院、活得久。
zh.whatis.p1: 这词你早就在用了。冲土狗的那个土狗。中文互联网早就把 memecoin 翻译完了，翻出来的不是音译词，是一条村里的土狗。
zh.whatis.p2: 所以这个项目的名字，就是这类东西的统称。你现在看的，是一个拿“土狗币”这三个字本身开的玩笑。
zh.whatis.p3: 它继承了 DOGE 和 SHIB 的血统。它也继承了它们的结局。
zh.whatis.p4: 顺便说一句：土狗在中文里从来不是骂狗的话。土狗皮实、好养、命长，村里人是拿它当夸奖用的。
zh.toocool.title: 土酷 · 土到极致便是潮
zh.toocool.p1: 土酷（Too Cool），约2016年由“养鸭”在短片《Too Cool To Be True》里提出。
zh.toocool.p2:
土，是山水壁纸贴满整面墙；是姥姥六点转发来的鎏金早安；是KTV顶上转的彩灯；是烫金匾额上的“富水长流”。土，本来是句骂人的话。
酷，在于“土”念出来就是英文的 too。所以土酷不是“土得可爱”，是 too cool——酷到最高级，太酷了，酷到不像真的。
zh.toocool.p3: 这里没有一个字是嘲笑。长辈发来的那张大字闪光祝福图，是真心的；那是他们用自己会用的语言，跟你说他们想你。我们把它做成一个网站，是因为我们喜欢它，不是因为我们瞧不起它。
zh.toocool.p4: 这面墙不是背景。在真正的屋子里，山水是从地板贴到天花板的，沙发就摆在瀑布前面。所以这一页也没有留白。
zh.toocool.comment: 视频底下的一条评论：“没文化，也是一种文化。”这就是整份设计说明。
zh.toocool.credit: 概念出处：“养鸭”，《Too Cool To Be True》，约 2016 年。

zh.plaques.noteRed: 关于“大展红图”：在中国股市和币圈，红是涨，绿是跌，跟你的看盘软件正好相反。所以“愿你满屏通红”是一句祝福。我们知道它翻成英文有多吓人。我们不改。
zh.plaques.noteFish: 关于“年年有U”：原句“年年有余”，余和鱼同音，所以这类画里永远有鱼。我们把余换成了U——U 就是中文币圈说的 USDT。

this is the landscape wallpaper covering an entire wall. the gold good-morning card your grandmother forwards at 6am. the ktv lights. the gold plaque.

plaques.noteZh: 原句是“细水长流”，劝人省着花。把“细”换成“富”，节俭就变成了富足——这是故意写错的成语，也是这一页的中心思想：钱要慢慢流，命要拿得住。一个整天喊梭哈的币，门口挂着一块金匾，劝你仓位小一点、拿久一点。
plaques.noteEn: the real idiom is 'a thin stream flows far' — spend sparingly so it lasts. swapping one character turns thrift into abundance. a coin whose entire premise is going all in hangs a gold sign telling you to size small and let it run.

plaques.noteZh: 不是古成语，是现代四字词。“暴”就是暴涨暴跌的那个暴，两头干的是同一件事。这四个字谁都盼过，包括我们。
plaques.noteEn: not a classical idiom — a modern four-character phrase, and the entire memecoin thesis was already sitting in the language. the 暴 here is the same 暴 as in 'violent pump' and 'violent dump'. it is doing the same job in both. everyone has wished for this one. us included.

plaques.noteZh: 元代《降桑椹》里就有：“招财进宝臻佳瑞。”传统上写成合体字——四个字焊成一个字，贴在门上。换句话说：一个交易对。两样东西焊死成一个，拆不开。
plaques.noteEn: the line is in the yuan-dynasty play 降桑椹: 'summon wealth, bring in treasure, and fine omens arrive'. traditionally written as one fused glyph, four characters welded into a single character on new year door stickers. which is to say: a liquidity pair. two assets welded into one token you cannot pull apart.

plaques.noteZh: 挂在自家大门上的那一句。而“出入”正好就是“出金／入金”——所以它是一句字面意义上正确的、真诚的祝福，祝你的出入金顺利。
plaques.noteEn: hung above the front door of a house. and 出 / 入 are literally the crypto words for withdrawal and deposit. so this is a sincere, literally correct blessing over your on-ramp and your off-ramp.

plaques.noteZh: 原句“年年有余”。余和鱼同音，所以过年要上一条整鱼，所以这类画里永远有鱼——这一页的锦鲤就是这条鱼。我们把余换成 U，U 是中文币圈说的 USDT。“年年有U”既是祝福，也是这一类东西里最现实的结果。
plaques.noteEn: the original is 'surplus every year'. surplus sounds like fish, which is why a whole fish is served at new year and why fish swim through every one of these pictures. we swapped it for U — what chinese traders call usdt. 'may you always have some usdt' is both a blessing and the most realistic outcome available.

plaques.en: MAY YOUR CHART BE ALL RED
plaques.noteZh: 原句“大展宏图”，是给刚创业的人的祝福。宏和红同音。中国市场红涨绿跌，所以“满屏通红”是祝福，不是诅咒。这句话翻成英文就成了诅咒——这个落差我们留着。
plaques.noteEn: the original is 'unfurl the grand design', a blessing for someone starting a business. 'grand' and 'red' are exact homophones. in chinese markets red means up and green means down — the reverse of the west. so this reads as a curse in english and a blessing in chinese. we are leaving the gap in.

plaques.noteZh: 牡丹的题词，画屏和山水壁纸上的常客。“开”是开盘、开仓的开——花开了，盘也开了。
plaques.noteEn: peony imagery, the standard caption on painted screens and on the wallpaper murals this page is built from. 開 is the 開 of 'market open' and 'open a position'. the flower opens; the candle opens.

plaques.noteZh: 出自《二十年目睹之怪现状》，升官的祝词。步步，就是一根一根 K 线。挂在一张明显没这么走的图上面，最合适。
plaques.noteEn: a promotion blessing, from the qing novel 二十年目睹之怪现状. step by step is candle by candle. best hung directly above a chart that is visibly not doing this.

plaques.noteZh: 钻石手，拿住，别动。这句话比“diamond hands”早两千年，而且这一页背后就有山。
plaques.noteEn: diamond hands, written in a language two thousand years older than diamond hands. the mountains behind this plaque are already on the wall.

plaques.en: WE DO NOT CHEAT CHILDREN OR THE ELDERLY
plaques.noteZh: 中国商铺最老的一块诚信招牌，写在门脸上几百年了。一个土狗币挂这四个字，要么是全场最好笑的，要么是全场最真诚的——底下那一段决定是哪个。
plaques.noteEn: the oldest honest-trader sign in chinese commerce, painted on shopfronts for centuries. a memecoin claiming this is either the funniest or the most sincere thing on the page. the section underneath decides which.

almanac.$comment: Each entry carries the 宜/忌 term in both languages (zh/en) and a gloss in both (noteZh/noteEn). The English note may not carry a joke, a claim or a citation the Chinese note does not — see the parity rule in the file header.

yi.noteZh: 黄历里的“开仓”是开粮仓，币圈的“开仓”是开仓位。同样两个字，我们一个字都没改。
yi.noteEn: good day to open a bag. 开仓 in the almanac means 'open the granary.' it is the same two characters traders use for 'open a position.' we did not do that.

yi.noteZh: 宜进财。这也是真黄历里的一条——黄历看多两千年了。
yi.noteEn: good day to receive wealth. also a real almanac entry. the almanac has been bullish for 2000 years.
pray first. buy second. in that order.

yi.noteZh: 宜给一件东西开光。今天这件东西是一个代币。
yi.noteEn: good day to consecrate an object. today the object is a token.

yi.noteZh: 拿住，别动。今天“什么都不做”被列成了一项正经事。
yi.noteEn: hold. do nothing. today, doing nothing is listed as an activity.

yi.noteZh: 宜蹲在草里等。买小一点，别声张。
yi.noteEn: good day to lie in the grass and wait. buy small. tell no one.

yi.noteZh: 宜每次买一点点，按时买，像个无聊的人。
yi.noteEn: good day to buy a little bit, on a schedule, like a boring person.

yi.noteZh: 宜种，不宜割。韭菜割了会再长——所以我们才叫韭菜。
yi.noteEn: good day to plant chives. not to cut them. chives grow back after cutting. that is why we are called chives.

yi.noteZh: 宜养牲口。这里的牲口是这条狗，这条狗就是这个币。
yi.noteEn: good day to keep an animal. the animal is this dog. the dog is the coin.

yi.noteZh: 宜见家人。顺手转一张卡过去，卡是免费的。
yi.noteEn: good day to see family. forward them a card. the card is free.

yi.noteZh: 看盘之前先去洗个澡。澡改变不了行情，能改变你。
yi.noteEn: shower before you look at the chart. it will not change the chart. it will change you.

yi.noteZh: 宜毕业：曲线填满，池子打开，家长在哭。
yi.noteEn: good day to graduate. the curve fills, the pool opens, the parents cry.

yi.noteZh: 宜出行。也宜在车还往上开的时候下车。
yi.noteEn: good day to travel. also to get off the bus while it is still going up.

ji.noteZh: 别全押进去。今天不行。明天那张黄历也会这么写。
ji.noteEn: do not put it all in. not today. tomorrow's almanac will also say this.

ji.noteZh: 别追高。高点不想被你抓住。
ji.noteEn: do not chase the top. the top does not want to be caught.

ji.noteZh: 别割肉。这根针还没走完。
ji.noteEn: do not cut the flesh. the wick is not finished.

ji.noteZh: 不加杠杆。这一条黄历写得格外硬。
ji.noteEn: no leverage. the almanac is unusually firm about this one.

ji.noteZh: 没读懂的东西别签。一次授权，四秒钟能清空一个钱包。
ji.noteEn: do not sign what you did not read. one signature can empty a wallet in four seconds.

ji.noteZh: 别点私信里的链接。没人给你空投。一个都没有。
ji.noteEn: do not click links in your dms. nobody is airdropping you. nobody.

ji.noteZh: 凌晨三点别看盘。它九点还在那儿，你也还在，大概。
ji.noteEn: do not check the chart at 3am. it will still be there at 9am. so will you, more or less.

ji.en: borrow to get on the bus
ji.noteZh: 别借钱上车。这车不往它说的地方开。
ji.noteEn: do not borrow money to get on the bus. the bus is not going where the bus says.

ji.noteZh: 别信路线图，包括这一张。这一张是日历。
ji.noteEn: do not believe roadmaps. including this one. this one is a calendar.

ji.noteZh: 别问什么时候上所。答案是没人知道，而告诉你的那个人正在卖。
ji.noteEn: do not ask when binance. the answer is nobody knows, and the person who told you is selling.

ji.noteZh: “塞穴”是黄历里真有的一条，意思是把口子堵上。它同时也精确地描述了貔貅盘。
ji.noteEn: do not plug the hole. 塞穴 is a genuine almanac entry meaning 'seal up an opening.' it is also, exactly, a honeypot contract.

ji.noteZh: 别跟庄对赌。你还没醒，图已经画好了。
ji.noteEn: do not bet against the whale. the whale drew the chart before you woke up.

ji.en: sell it and watch it fly
ji.noteZh: 别卖飞。这一条躲不掉，我们还是写上。
ji.noteEn: do not sell it and then watch it fly. this one is unavoidable. we list it anyway.

ji.noteZh: 别说这次不一样。这次和上次一样——这个名字说的就是这件事。
ji.noteEn: do not say this one is different. this one is not different. that is the point of the name.

rows.zh: 总量 1,000,000,000 枚，一枚不多，一枚不少。
rows.en: total supply 1,000,000,000. not one more. not one less.
no honeypot. you can buy and you can sell.

tokenomics.$comment: verified:false on every row. These are template placeholders. Replace with real on-chain values before launch or delete the block — the honest section says 请核验，别信我们 and the page cannot print an unverified fairness claim four sections earlier. Medal text must stay folk-decorative: never SEC APPROVED, never AUDITED BY, never a fake exchange endorsement.

buySteps.zh: 第二步　买点主链币，留够 gas。
buySteps.en: step two. buy some of the chain's own coin and keep enough for gas.

buySteps.zh: 第三步　只从本页复制合约地址。认准官方，别信私信，别信“客服”。
buySteps.en: step three. copy the contract address from this page and only this page. nobody in your dms is support. there is no support.

buySteps.zh: 第四步　滑点稍微调高一点，然后……随缘。
buySteps.en: step four. raise your slippage a little. after that it is up to fate.

familyRules.zh: 一、不喊单，不带单，不预测价格。
familyRules.en: one. no price calls, no shilling, no predictions.

familyRules.zh: 二、有人亏了，就说一句：没事，人比币重要。
familyRules.en: two. if somebody loses money, you say: it's fine, people matter more than coins.

familyRules.zh: 三、每天早上发一张图。手机随手拍的也行，越热闹越好。
familyRules.en: three. post a picture every morning. a phone snapshot counts. the louder the better.

wishPresets.en: may wealth flow in from every direction

glossary.defZh: 村口那条谁都认识的狗，正式名称中华田园犬；在币圈指没团队、没审计、没白皮书的小市值新币。
glossary.en: dirt dog. a mongrel village dog; in crypto, a no-name micro-cap token with no team, no audit and no whitepaper.
glossary.usageZh: “今天冲了三个土狗，两个归零。”正式名称是中华田园犬。这个词不贬低狗——土狗皮实、命长，村里人是拿它当夸奖用的。
glossary.usageEn: 'aped three tugou today, two went to zero.' the formal word for the animal is 中华田园犬, the chinese pastoral dog. not derogatory toward the dog: these dogs are hardy and long-lived, and in the village that is said as praise.

glossary.defZh: meme 币。不是“某一种 meme 币”——这三个字就是中文里这个品类的名字。
glossary.en: memecoin. not 'a kind of memecoin' — this IS the chinese word for the category.
glossary.usageZh: 百度百科开篇：“土狗币，中文名亦作‘MeMe币’”。这一句是整个项目的地基。
glossary.usageEn: baidu baike opens its entry with exactly this. that single line is the load-bearing fact of the whole project.

glossary.defZh: 涨了一百倍、混出头的土狗。SHIB 是标准案例。
glossary.en: golden dog. a tugou that went up 100x and became respectable. SHIB is the canonical example.
glossary.usageZh: “土狗和金狗是可以互相转化的。”有人营销的土狗会变成金狗；没人管的金狗，比土狗还难看。
glossary.usageEn: they convert into each other. a well-marketed tugou becomes a golden dog; a golden dog nobody markets becomes worse than a tugou.

glossary.usageZh: “冲不冲？”“冲！”——整个决策流程。所以这一页的按钮上写的是“冲”，不是“买入”。
glossary.usageEn: 'are we sending it?' 'send it.' that is the entire decision-making process. this is why the button says 冲 and not 买入.

glossary.en: get on the bus / get off the bus. buy in / sell out.
glossary.usageZh: “求上车”。“车门焊死”＝谁也别想下车，是一句忠诚宣言，不是威胁。
glossary.usageEn: 'let me on the bus.' 'the doors are welded shut' is said as a promise of loyalty, not a threat.

glossary.defZh: 全押。来自粤语的“show hand”，经九十年代香港赌片进了普通话。
glossary.en: all in. from the cantonese card game 'show hand', by way of 1990s hong kong gambling films.
glossary.usageZh: “梭哈了”＝全押进去了。一把定输赢，没有第二次——这就是这个词带着的味道。
glossary.usageEn: one hand, no second chance. that is the flavor the word carries.

glossary.en: chives. retail investors, who exist to be harvested.
glossary.usageZh: “我就是个老韭菜”——这个词几乎永远是自嘲，对着别人说就难听了。韭菜割了会再长，所以才有人一直割。
glossary.usageEn: overwhelmingly self-applied. the metaphor is precise: chives grow back after cutting, which is exactly why the market keeps cutting. keep it self-directed; never aim it at the reader.

glossary.usageZh: “99% 的土狗在热度消退后接近归零。”注意“归零”的归，和“满载而归”是同一个归——这一页故意把这两个词摆在一起。
glossary.usageEn: note that 归 (to return) is the same character as in 'return home laden'. this page puts those two next to each other on purpose.

glossary.defZh: 别卖，攥住。中文里的 HODL，而且比 HODL 早得多。
glossary.en: hold on. keep your grip. the native HODL, and older than HODL.
glossary.usageZh: “拿住了，别动。”比“钻石手”更平实、更暖，像一句真心的劝。
glossary.usageEn: plainer and warmer than 'diamond hands'. it sounds like advice from someone who likes you.

glossary.defZh: 项目方带着流动性消失。英文叫 rug pull。
glossary.en: to run. the dev abandons the project and takes the liquidity. rug pull.
glossary.usageZh: “项目方跑路了。”比 rug 范围更宽——弃坑也算。
glossary.usageEn: slightly broader than 'rug': it covers abandonment as well as theft.

glossary.defZh: 只能买、不能卖的合约。英文叫 honeypot。
glossary.en: honeypot contract. you can buy, you cannot sell.
glossary.usageZh: 貔貅有嘴无肛，只进不出，所以它既是玉器店里的招财神兽，也是这种合约的名字。同一尊像，摆在架子上是祝福，写进合约里是骗局。
glossary.usageEn: named for the mythical beast with a mouth and no anus. the same statue is a blessing on a shelf and a rug-pull on a chain.

glossary.en: USDT. said as the english letter.
glossary.usageZh: 收U、出U、U本位。这就是“年年有U”这块匾成立的原因。
glossary.usageEn: 'take payment in U', 'sell for U', 'denominate in U'. this is what makes the 'usdt every year' plaque work.

originatorNote.zh: 只署经核实的网名。个人名的汉字尚未确认，未确认前不写。
originatorNote.en: handle only. the hanzi of the personal name are not confirmed, and this page does not ship a guessed spelling.
